subject: Novastar renewal paperwork: errata on order form & exhibit sequencing
body:
From: Lisa Park <lisa.park@novastar.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>
Cc: Joe Sullivan <joe.sullivan@novastar.com>
Date: Tue, 09 Nov 2027 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Novastar renewal: draft order form and a couple of errata

Hi Evelyn —

Thanks for sending over the renewal packet. We skimmed the order form and have two quick errata we want captured before legal moves to signature:

1) Term: the commercial sponsor is asking to extend the initial term to 18 months (instead of 12) to align with budgeting cycles. Could you confirm pricing/commit mechanics if we do 18 months?

2) Exhibit B: coverage table appears to reference older region names and a tier labeling mismatch (Tier 2 / Burst). I've attached our annotated draft.

Can you route the updated redline to procurement/legal and confirm whether Redwood can accept the 18-month initial term (or provide a 12-month + auto-renew option)? Also need SOC 2 attestation and the most recent retention policy to be referenced in Exhibit C.

Attachment: Novastar_Renewal_Draft_20271109.pdf (pdf, 1 page — annotated)

Thanks,
Lisa Park
Head of Procurement
Novastar

----

From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>
To: Lisa Park <lisa.park@novastar.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 09 Nov 2027 11:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Novastar renewal: draft order form and a couple of errata

Hi Lisa — thanks for the clear notes. Looping in Ben (sales lead on this deal) and Neha (legal ops) to triage the two asks. Quick plan: Ben will validate pricing for an 18-month upfront commit vs 12+auto-renew, Neha will take the Exhibit B coverage mapping and the SOC2/retention hook.

Ben / Neha — see Lisa’s attachments and the two asks above. Ben, can you confirm the unit economics if Novastar moves to an 18-month initial term? If not feasible, can we propose 12 months + automatic 12-month renewal with pro-rated billing for the overlap?

I'll assemble a single redline (PDF) for Novastar legal and route for DocuSign once we land on wording.

Thanks — Evelyn
Evelyn Hart
Senior Account Manager | Redwood Inference
---

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Cc: Lisa Park <lisa.park@novastar.com>
Date: Tue, 09 Nov 2027 14:25:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Novastar renewal: draft order form and a couple of errata

Evelyn / Neha / Lisa — quick update from pricing ops after an initial pass: we can support an 18-month initial term at a 6% blended discount vs the 12-month list price, provided the committed capacity (seat/GPU units) is locked at signing and billing is upfront for the first 9 months with the remaining 9 months invoiced at the start of month 10.

If Novastar prefers simpler billing, we can do a 12-month initial term with automatic renewals (12-months) and a one-time option to renegotiate on renewal anniversary; that path preserves current unit pricing but defers any extended-term discount.

Exhibit B: attached a cleaned coverage matrix with the Tier labels aligned to Redwood internal tiers and a short note mapping Novastar’s burst usage to our surge bucket. Neha — I left three inline comments around SLA exceptions for managed Dedicated pools (we should not pre-approve exceptions without SOC2/pen-test evidence).

Attachments: Novastar_OrderForm_v3_redline.pdf (pdf, 3 pages — inline comments), Exhibit-B_coverage_matrix.xlsx (xlsx, 1 sheet)

Proposed next step: Neha to confirm legal language for term/billing, Evelyn to consolidate into single redline, then circulate to Novastar legal for a quick signoff.

Ben Carter
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference

>
> I'll assemble a single redline (PDF) for Novastar legal and route for DocuSign once we land on wording.
>

----

From: Joe Sullivan <joe.sullivan@novastar.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 10 Nov 2027 15:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Novastar renewal: draft order form and a couple of errata

Evelyn / Ben / Neha — thanks for the quick turnaround. Novastar legal reviewed the redline and we can accept the majority of your proposed edits, with two requested clarifications before we can sign:

1) Indemnity carve: we need a narrow IP carve for customer-provided data and a reciprocal limitation cap aligned to the committed spend over the initial term. Proposed language attached as a mark-up on Section 6.

2) Data deletion / retention: please add a sentence to Exhibit C that explicitly references Redwood’s standard data retention policy and the window for customer deletion upon termination. We will require the SOC 2 report (Type II) before we finalize any SLA exceptions.

We are happy to accept the 18-month term at the 6% blended discount as long as the billing cadence is laid out in the order form. Once you include the two clarifications above, we can route for signature via DocuSign.

Forwarded-For-Context: (see prior redline thread and Exhibit-B attachment)

Regards,
Joe Sullivan
Senior Counsel, Contracts
Novastar

Attachment: Novastar_Legal_markup_Section6.docx (docx, 2 pages — redline)

---

Notes: Next steps for Redwood — Neha to draft the indemnity/scope language consistent with our risk tolerance, Ben to update the order form with the billing schedule, Evelyn to merge into final redline PDF and share DocuSign link.
